selections.title: (42) IPv4_MulticastRouting - PIM-SSM
selections.justification:
PIM-SMM is entered entries dynamically Multicast traffic is forwarded and status on multicast table is correct when group was joined:
>Check Multicast Table (show ip mroute; show ip pim spare-mode mroute)
>Check IGMP Groups (show ip igmp group)
>Check IGMP Host Joined the correct multicast source | Multicast traffic was stopped and prune correctly when group was left and multicast table updated correctly:
>Check Multicast Table (show ip mroute; show ip pim spare-mode mroute)
>Check IGMP Groups (show ip igmp group)
>Check when all IGMP Host leave the group | The state when port interface does down/up:
>Check Multicast Table (show ip mroute; show ip pim spare-mode mroute)
>Check IGMP Groups (show ip igmp group)
>Check when no more IGMP Host connected

step4.objective:
• The port with no pluggable defaults to automatic MDI/MDIX polarity handling.
  • Inserting a supported pluggable resolves polarity and establishes link.
  • A port configured for Auto speed and duplex establishes a link with a compliant partner.
  • The port accurately reports Auto mode together with the negotiated speed and duplex values.
